description: This source file implements a certificate verification tool for the Chromium project, supporting multiple verification methods and configurations, including system trust stores, Chrome trust store, and custom trust settings. It handles reading certificates, setting up network contexts, and executing verification sequences based on command-line options.

classes.name: CertVerifyImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class for different certificate verification implementations.

classes.name: CertVerifyImplUsingProc
classes.description: Implementation of CertVerifyImpl using a specific CertVerifyProc.

methods.name: GetUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string for network requests.

methods.name: SetUpOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Initializes network context and fetcher on a dedicated thread.

methods.name: ShutdownOnNetworkThread
methods.description: Shuts down network context and fetcher on the network thread.

methods.name: CreateSystemTrustStore
methods.description: Creates a trust store based on the specified root store type.

methods.name: CreateCertVerifyImplFromName
methods.description: Factory function to create a CertVerifyImpl based on implementation name.

methods.name: PrintCertHashAndSubject
methods.description: Prints the fingerprint and subject of a certificate.

methods.name: PrintUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage information for the tool.
